rationale: The agent correctly verified the user using full name and zip, inspected the user’s orders, identified the relevant delivered laptop (15-inch, i5, 16GB, 512GB), found an available variant matching i7/8GB/1TB, and executed an exchange with the correct price difference charged to the stored payment method. However, the agent performed an order-changing write (initiated the exchange) without first stating the exact change and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation, which violates a core policy requirement. Additionally, there were two delivered laptops on the account and the agent did not confirm which one to exchange before proceeding. Some post-action details (e.g., that an email with instructions will be sent and shipping begins after the return is processed) were plausible but not explicitly supported by tool outputs. The primary failure is initiating the exchange without explicit user confirmation.
